title: Historic Stone Academy offers pumpkin decorating and paranormal adventure
excerpt: Muskingum County History will host a family pumpkin event Sept. 29 and a ghost tour Oct. 10 at the historic Stone Academy.
content:
Sept. 27, 2026, 5:03 a.m. ET

Muskingum County History will host two fall-themed events at the Stone Academy in Putnam, offering family activities and a late-night paranormal tour.

The programs are scheduled for Sept. 29 and Oct. 10 at the historic landmark at 115 Jefferson St., according to a community announcement. Activities range from crafts and games for children to a walking tour focused on local ghost stories.

Pumpkins and Pastries is set for 3:30 to 7:30 p.m. Sept. 29. Visitors can take part in historic games, create free fall-themed crafts and tour the Stone Academy at no charge.

Attendees may also purchase a s'mores kit for $3 to use at the fire pit and buy a pumpkin to decorate for $5.

A ghostly stories walking tour and investigation will be offered from 7:45 p.m. to midnight Oct. 10 at the Stone Academy.

The event costs $50 and will include a walking tour through historic neighborhoods believed to be haunted, according to the announcement. Organizers said the tour is expected to last about an hour.

Tickets are available by calling 740-270-9990.

The Stone Academy is located in the Putnam Historic District. Built in 1809, the building hosted abolitionist activities and later became a stop on the Underground Railroad.
